messages:
lee: seeing repeated short GPU stalls in eu-north1 over last 2 hours. correlates with small group of tenants causing PCIe DMA retries + egress microbursts. sample tenant=tenant-iris. thoughts? :thinking:

pat: can you paste the prom query you used?

lee: ```sum(rate(kv_out_bytes{region="eu-north1"}[1m])) by (tenant)``` plus node counters: pcie_dma_retries, nic_tx_qdepth, gpu_runqueue_seconds_p95

infra-bot: Alert eu-north1_pcie_egress_burst started at 2024-12-05T02:12:11Z severity=warning alert_id=eun-pcie-221

sana: likely NIC microbursts driving DMA retries which stall GPU threads. short-term: try NIC txq steering + lightweight eBPF pacing per-pod before eviction. prefer same-region hosted fallback if pacing fails.

omar: agree. eBPF redirect is low-risk. proto config: ```program: txq_steer v0.2 mode=ebpf_redirect params:txq_limit=32 burst_sec=15 rate_mbps=90 fallback=hosted-eu-north1 emit:tenant_steer_hits, rerouted_tokens_est```

pat: detection heuristic to avoid noise: ```WHEN kv_out_rate(tenant)>100MB/2m AND pcie_dma_retries>0 AND nic_tx_qdepth_p95>30 FOR 60s```

sana: ops playbook draft:
- canary on 3% of fractional slices eu-north1 for 48h
- sequence: 1) emit tenant_steer_hits, monitor pcie_retry_rate 2) if no improvement after 30s, async warm-rehome -> chilled host 3) if warm clone fails in 90s, reroute to same-region hosted 4) notify owner on first reroute, auto-ticket if >3 reroutes/hr

lee: cost quick calc: tenant-iris ~700k bytes in 5m -> ~26k tokens -> ~$0.07 if rerouted to hosted for that window. But preventing repeated 30-60s neighbor stalls likely saves more gpu-minutes. Tag reroutes with billing:pcie_mitigation=true

omar: metrics to add: tenant_steer_hits, rerouted_tokens_est, slice_txq_backpressure_seconds, warm_clone_latency_ms. Optimize wants 72h of metrics before global rollout.

pat: owners: Omar -> eBPF PR + staging deploy, Sana -> alert rule + runbook, Lee -> cost tagging + canary telemetry.

deploy-bot: scheduled txq_steer v0.2 to staging at 1830060000 (ETA 14:00 UTC).

lee: ok canary after staging deploy + 24h smoke. thumbs up? :thumbsup:
